words.definition: Keeps unmatched rows from BOTH sides, filling missing columns with NULL.

words.definition: Generalised Inverted iNdex (Postgres) — for columns holding many values per row: arrays, JSONB, full-text.

words.definition: Generalised Search Tree (Postgres) — for geometric, range, and nearest-neighbour queries (PostGIS, ranges).

words.definition: Maps a hashed key to a location — fast for exact equality only, no ranges or sorting.

words.definition: Returns only rows that match in BOTH tables. The default — JOIN with no qualifier means INNER JOIN.

words.definition: Keeps every row from the left table; right-table columns are NULL where there is no match.

words.definition: Turns an aggregate or window function into a window — it computes per row WITHOUT collapsing rows like GROUP BY does.

sentences.ru: Старший инженер должен уметь ясно говорить о понятии «OVER».

words.definition: Splits rows into groups for a window function — like GROUP BY, but the rows are kept.
words.example: In practice: SELECT dept, name, salary, AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY dept) AS dept_avg FROM employees;.

In a coding interview, can you explain what PARTITION BY means?

sentences.en: A senior engineer should be able to discuss PARTITION BY clearly.
sentences.ru: Старший инженер должен уметь ясно говорить о понятии «PARTITION BY».

words.definition: Re-running a range query returns new rows that another committed transaction inserted in between.

sentences.en: In practice: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE total > 100; -- run twice: count grows because a row was inserted.

sentences.en: A senior engineer should be able to discuss phantom read clearly.
sentences.ru: Старший инженер должен уметь ясно говорить о понятии «phantom read».

words.definition: Rank rows by an ORDER BY. RANK leaves gaps after ties (1,1,3); DENSE_RANK does not (1,1,2).

sentences.en: A senior engineer should be able to discuss RANK / DENSE_RANK clearly.
sentences.ru: Старший инженер должен уметь ясно говорить о понятии «RANK / DENSE_RANK».

words.definition: Each statement only sees data committed before it started. The default in PostgreSQL and Oracle.

sentences.ru: На собеседовании: можете объяснить, что такое READ COMMITTED?

words.definition: Weakest isolation level — a transaction can read another’s uncommitted changes (dirty reads allowed).

sentences.ru: Старший инженер должен уметь ясно говорить о понятии «READ UNCOMMITTED».

words.definition: Rows you read once stay the same for the whole transaction. MySQL InnoDB’s default.

words.definition: Mirror of LEFT JOIN — keeps every row from the right table. Rare in practice; people just flip the tables.

words.definition: A table joined to itself, using aliases, to relate rows within the same table (e.g. employee → manager).

words.definition: Strongest level — transactions behave as if run one after another. Prevents phantoms at the cost of more aborts/locks.

words.definition: Include everything — hidden files, stopped containers, tracked and untracked changes — instead of just the default subset.
